column1: # SandboxGuard blacklist vectors, shared by the C++ suite (Test 33) and the Rust core tests.
# Columns (tab separated): name, path, expected category.
# Categories: allowed, empty, drive_root, critical_file, windows_dir, windows_other_drive, common_files, system_volume_information.
# "<empty>" stands for the empty path. The vectors assume Windows lives in C:\Windows (the C++ test checks it).
# Several rows record behaviour that looks odd but is what the C++ code does today (e.g. C:\WindowsApps is blocked
# by prefix); the Rust implementation must reproduce it exactly, not "fix" it.
